variables.role: dragon, a scaled non-human reptilian beast with horns and folded wings, no human features

items.prompt: waist-up portrait of one non-binary dragon, a scaled non-human reptilian beast with horns and folded wings, no human features, alone in the picture, centered and facing the viewer, clothing and colour scheme silver, guarding a hoard, background: garden, painted fantasy illustration, full bleed, detailed
items.bio: Brass gears whir in Sample's scales, mirroring the garden's silver sheen. They tend to the roses, humming softly as if teaching them to sing. Every petal, a tiny, gleaming trophy, they claim without a bite.
